profile.headline: Sr Python Developer and Sr. Cloud DevOps Architect | AWS, GCP, Azure, IaC
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Tempus, Inc., I’ve played a key role in advancing precision medicine through innovative cloud solutions. At Tempus, a leading tech company valued at $8 billion, I spearhead the design and deployment of scalable, secure infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to support critical healthcare initiatives.

I’ve implemented CI/CD pipelines, optimized Docker golden images, and developed Python scripts that have significantly reduced provisioning times and enhanced system reliability. My work involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and alignment with business goals, all while maintaining a strong focus on security and performance.

I’m passionate about driving innovation and fostering a collaborative environment, contributing to the optimization of processes that ultimately improve patient outcomes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded the design and deployment of scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to support the Workspaces initiative.
•	Developed and maintained critical software components, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and optimizing performance for large-scale data analysis tasks.
•	Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, DevOps engineers, and product managers, to align technical solutions with business objectives.
•	Implemented continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using industry-standard tools like Concourse, GitHub Actions, Playwright, and Terraform to automate workflows and reduce time to production.
•	Enhanced the security posture of the Workspaces environment by integrating Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, Google Cloud Security Command Center, and automated monitoring solutions using Django, Prometheus and Grafana.
•	Played a key role in the optimization of Docker golden images, improving consistency and reducing provisioning times for new workspaces.
•	Guided junior engineers and new team members, fostering a collaborative environment and promoting best practices in software development and cloud architecture.
•	Developed Python scripts for process automation and improved reliability.
•	Contributed to the automation efforts, reducing the time required for provisioning new workspaces from 5 days to just one day.
positions.insights: Software Development, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and +4 skills

positions.title: Sr. Python Developer and Sr. DevOps Architect
positions.description:
•	Expertly managed AWS & Azure Services including EC2/VM, S3/Blob, Route53/DNS, CloudWatch/Monitor, ECS/ACS, EKS/AKS, SNS, VPC, DynamoDB, CloudTrail, AWS DMS, EMR, and SQS, integrating these services with Python-based web frameworks for robust management systems.
•	Developed and maintained sophisticated management systems using Django, ensuring high performance and scalability, and integrating with cloud infrastructure for comprehensive system management.
•	Architected and implemented microservices using Flask, facilitating efficient, lightweight service management and communication within cloud environments.
•	Utilized Django's ORM and Flask's minimalistic approach to create and manage databases, optimizing data interaction for cloud-based applications and services.
•	Enhanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates using Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation, and Azure Resource Manager, integrating Django and Flask for improved system manageability and automation.
•	Demonstrated advanced Python scripting for automation and configuration, specifically within Django and Flask environments, to streamline cloud infrastructure management and operations.
•	Automated deployment and scaling of Django and Flask applications using Terraform, Cloud Formation, and ECS/ACS, significantly reducing deployment time.
•	Implemented a CI/CD pipeline using Code Pipeline and Code Build, with Django and Flask applications enhancing release frequency and deployment reliability.
•	Enforced security best practices in the Django and Flask applications, including role-based permissions and strong password policies, ensuring robust application and data security.

positions.title: Python Developer and AWS DevOps Architect
positions.locationName: Albuquerque, New Mexico, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Architected and configured Dev/Stage/QA environments in AWS integrated with VPC, subnets, security groups, EC2 instances, load balancer, RDS, Redis & Route53, Cloud Formation, Cloud Watch, SQS, IAM, and S3.
•	Planning, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining Amazon AWS cloud infrastructure consisting of multiple EC2 nodes and VMWare VMs as required in the environment.
•	Used security groups, network ACLs, Internet Gateways, NAT instances, and Route53 tables to ensure a secure zone for organizations in AWS public cloud.
•	Onboarded and migrated test and staging use cases for applications to AWS cloud with public and private IP ranges to increase development productivity by reducing test-run times.
•	Created monitors, alarms, and notifications for EC2 hosts using CloudWatch.
•	Implemented and maintained Chef Configuration management spanning several environments in VMware and the AWS cloud.
•	Worked on Multiple AWS instances, set the security groups, Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) and AMIs, and Auto scaling to design cost-effective, fault-tolerant, and highly available systems.
•	Creating S3 buckets and managing policies for S3 buckets and utilizing S3 bucket and Glacier for Archival storage and backup on AWS.
•	Designed AWS CloudFormation templates to create custom sized VPC, subnets, and NAT to ensure successful deployment of Web applications and database templates.
•	Utilize AWS CLI to automate backups of ephemeral data stores to S3 buckets, and EBS and create nightly AMIs for mission-critical production servers as backups.
•	Containerized the services using the Docker for the test environments and dev-environment needs as well as configuration automation using Docker.
•	Created Docker images using a Docker file, worked on Docker container snapshots, removed images, and managed Docker volumes.
•	Expert Knowledge in Bash Shell Scripting and automation using cron Jobs.
•	Implemented Continuous Integration using Jenkins and Git.

positions.title: Python Developer and Linux Administrator
positions.description:
•	Python Web Development with Django: Leveraged Python and the Django framework to architect and develop scalable and robust web applications. This encompassed end-to-end application creation, enhancements, and ongoing maintenance, ensuring high performance and security standards.
•	Python Scripting and Automation: Devised Python scripts to automate a wide range of system administration tasks and streamline application deployment processes. These scripts significantly improved operational efficiency and minimized potential errors. Additionally, they were instrumental in tasks such as log analysis, resource monitoring, and data transformations.
•	Linux Server Administration: Orchestrated the installation, configuration, and administration of Red Hat Linux servers, along with continuous management of Linux OS updates (RHEL 4x, 5x, SUSE 10, 11, CentOS) and hardware maintenance, including memory module upgrades and disk drive replacements.
•	Web Application Deployment and Server Configuration: Proficiently implemented and configured Django-based web applications on servers, ensuring seamless operation, optimal performance, and robust security.
•	Database Management: Successfully handled the configuration and management of databases integral to Django applications, optimizing their performance and maintaining data integrity.
•	Monitoring CPU, memory, physical disk, hardware, and software raid, multipath, file systems, and network using the tools Nagios 4.0 monitoring.
•	Writing shell scripts for automation of daily tasks, documenting the changes that happen in the environment and each server, analyzing the error logs, analyzing the user logs, and analyzing the /var/log/syslog.
